<infobox theme="Location">
	<image source="imagefallback">
		<default>{{InfoboxGallery|image={{{image|}}}|caption1={{{option1|}}}|image2={{{image2|}}}|caption2={{{option2|}}}}}</default>
	</image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>	
        <data source="created"><label>Constructed</label></data>	
        <data source="destroyed"><label>Destroyed</label></data>
        <data source="type"><label>Type</label></data>	
        <data source="location"><label>Location</label></data>	
        <data source="terrain"><label>Terrain</label></data>
        <data source="interest"><label>Points of interest</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Chronological and political information</header>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Location|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
	-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|name|created|destroyed|type|location|terrain|interest|affiliation|optional=option1,image2,option2,unlisted,flora,fauna|ignore=name}}{{#if:{{{unlisted|}}}|[[Category:Locations unlisted in the Appendix]]|}}{{#if:{{{flora|}}}{{{fauna|}}}|[[Category:Flora or fauna usages]]|}}<noinclude>[[Category:Location infobox templates]]

===Usage===
To use this template, paste the following code into the top of the article, filling all relevant fields:
<pre><nowiki>{{Top|}}
{{Location
|image=
|name=
|created=
|destroyed=
|type=
|location=
|terrain=
|interest=
|affiliation=
}}</nowiki></pre></noinclude>
